### 
## Why is our food Never Kibbled™?
![](https://cdn.builder.io/api/v1/image/assets%2F0e70bd0bca2c432ca91ef8818692fb02%2Ff6e3304b54834abcad66dd447d32a08d?width=135)
The average store-bought pet food is blasted with nutrient-destroying heat and often made with low-quality ingredients.
![](https://cdn.builder.io/api/v1/image/assets%2F0e70bd0bca2c432ca91ef8818692fb02%2F309f7bc23ea54d11ad7bf4a3db9e4dda?width=135)
Dr. Marty's is Never Kibbled. Instead, we gently freeze-dry your pet's food to help protect the nutrients that help keep them trim, active, healthy, and happy.
### 
Ingredients
Nature’s Feast contains: Salmon, Turkey, Whitefish, Chicken Liver, Chicken Heart, Chicken Gizzard, Sweet Potato, Flaxseed, Egg, Pumpkin Seeds, Peas, Carrot, Apple, Blueberry, Cranberry, Ginger, Salt, Kelp, Sunflower Seeds, Spinach, Broccoli, Kale, Mixed Tocopherols (preservatives)
###

4734 kcal/kg, 246 kcal/cup
